correctness.rationale: For Q the eleven nonzero quadratic residues modulo 23, the 23 translates v+Q are precisely the out-neighborhoods; independent enumeration gives 42,297 faces and face vector (23,253,1771,6325,10373,10626,7590,3795,1265,253,23). Independently replayed deterministic elementary free-face collapses: 19,184 pairs, 3,929 nonempty surviving faces. A second 1,856-pair Morse matching has a full 3,929-node/14,596-arrow DAG topological order, leaving one 0-cell, 212 3-cells and four 4-cells. Independent exact gradient recursion gave four signed columns with lengths (26,27,55,26), c0-c1-c2+c3=0, and 3x3 unit determinant -1 at critical 3-face masks 8724,133252,270360. Thus integral 4-to-3 boundary has Smith invariants (1,1,1,0). Since the three-skeleton is a wedge of 212 S3, the Hurewicz isomorphism identifies attaching maps by degrees, yielding precisely (∨209 S3)∨S4, no hidden torsion. This does not claim other tournament orders.
